clue.text: Not acknowledge hell's personal

clue.text: Lack of children a trivial concern?

clue.text: What one needs to know, neatly arranged

clue.text: Wounded under fire, finally survive

clue.text: Face bombs, and get on

clue.text: Having dined, eating beef, a bit off-colour

clue.text: Old kingdom, and one in daydream there?
